# DHgate

> DHgate is a global wholesale ecommerce marketplace connecting buyers with Chinese suppliers for bulk purchasing across diverse product categories.

DHgate operates as a B2B wholesale platform enabling international buyers to source products directly from Chinese manufacturers and suppliers. The platform supports multiple languages including Arabic and provides buyer protection mechanisms for secure transactions.

## Key Topics

- Wholesale marketplace
- Chinese suppliers
- Bulk buying
- Ecommerce platform
- Product categories
- Buyer protection
- International trade
- Direct sourcing
- B2B commerce
- Supplier network
